label: Small Biotech IND Starter — FDA 1571 Narrative
description: Narrative companion to Form FDA 1571 for a Phase 1 IND from a small biotech.

inputs.study_design: a first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation study evaluating safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy in adult patients with R/R DLBCL who have received ≥2 prior lines of therapy
inputs.nonclinical_summary: Nonclinical evaluation included in vitro binding and cytotoxicity assays, in vivo efficacy in DLBCL xenograft models, and GLP toxicology studies in cynomolgus monkeys (4-week repeat dose). Key findings: dose-dependent tumor regression in xenograft models; NOAEL of 10 mg/kg in monkey studies with cytokine release at ≥30 mg/kg.
inputs.previous_human_experience: No prior human experience. This is a first-in-human study.
inputs.clinical_site: Massachusetts General Hospital Cancer Center, Boston, MA
